email.subject1: a signal play for dbt Labs
email.body1:
Mackenzie, saw dbt Labs announce the Fivetran merger and ship the Fusion Engine, with up to 50% cost savings.

A combination that size usually opens more majors accounts than the team can cover during integration, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for dbt off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Mackenzie, quick follow-up for dbt Labs.

Through a merger, the majors pipeline target usually outpaces what the team can cover while territories shift. Most directors cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many majors meetings you need this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Mackenzie, last bit of proof for dbt Labs.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how dbt's reply rate likely compares to other data-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Mackenzie, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling majors pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A merger integration is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your majors motion? I will tailor it to dbt either way.
